The showdown at the Takarazuka Kinen came 
to a close with Biwa Hayahide's victory.

After the race, Winning Ticket tells Biwa 
Hayahide that she wants them to keep 
competing in the best races together as 
rivals.

However, Biwa Hayahide replied that unlike 
during the Nippon Derby, she could no 
longer see the current Winning Ticket as a 
rival.

“You should reconsider what you are 
running for.” Biwa Hayahide's words left 
Winning Ticket in absolute stunned 
silence.
